Targets may be hostnames, IPv4 or IPv6. ICMP ignores the port; TCP/UDP use it. Failure means that target/protocol did not respond successfully, not necessarily that the whole PC is offline. Servers may block ICMP or not reply to UDP.

Headway may also be an = expression. Example: {= if(memory.usage >= 80, 'High', 'OK')}.
